Profile

Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group, or MUFG, is the largest bank in Japan in terms of market capitalization and assets. It offers services including commercial banking, trust banking, securities, credit cards, consumer finance, asset management, and leasing. MUFG also generates substantial revenue and profits outside Japan (more than 30% of its loans are outside Japan) as it provides services to Japanese corporates overseas, local consumers and businesses in Southeast Asia, and non-Japanese global corporates. MUFG also owns a 24% stake in Morgan Stanley.
